name: Wit of the Dying Plain
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One or two creatures
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suffers 3d6 points of phrenic damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. The target is subjected to the ‘dazed’ condition.

Throughout the encounter, if the creature that failed this saving throw and is within your reach moves out of a square you threaten, you are allowed to make an attack of opportunity against it. This holds true even in situations where such a movement would not typically provoke an attack of opportunity.
